name: Joker Admin Colors
author: jokerinthepack

sections.description:
Joker Admin Colors lets you design your own WordPress admin colour schemes without writing any code.

  • Build schemes from eight colours: menu background, menu text, highlight, notification badges, page background, links, buttons and form focus
  • Live preview while you pick colours
  • Two ready-made schemes included: Joker Graphite and Joker Noir
  • Checkboxes, radios and focus rings follow your scheme, not WordPress blue
  • Apply a scheme to every user in one click
  • Optionally force a scheme so users cannot change it
  • Every scheme also appears on each user’s profile screen

Joker Admin Colors Pro

The Pro edition adds premium admin styling, a branded dashboard with stats and shortcuts, your logo in the toolbar and sidebar, custom menu icons and an agency support widget. Find out more at jokerinthepack.co.uk.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New Plugin, or upload the zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Admin Colors in the sidebar.
  4. Create a scheme, or use Apply Site-Wide to move every user onto Joker Graphite.
sections.faq:
Some users still see the default WordPress colours

WordPress stores a colour choice for each user. Use Apply Site-Wide > Apply to All Users, and tick Force this scheme to lock it.

Where are the scheme files stored?

Each scheme is saved as a small stylesheet in wp-content/uploads/jacf-schemes/. Use Regenerate All CSS after moving your site.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

All schemes and settings are removed and every user goes back to the default WordPress colour scheme.
